decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen has won gold medals from the German bread institute again and again and is publicly promoted under the firm's name, so it is a visible flagship that management would never write off.

The dark barley malt rye bread has kept its own page through 2024 while its sister breads were dropped, which suggests it survived scrutiny, and it costs little to keep within the established bread line.
The marzipan stollen sits next to the award-winning stollen line on its own page each season, so it is part of the firm's publicly presented Christmas assortment and fits the core offer.
